derivation_engine_hash.meaning: Deterministic canonical JSON SHA-256 digest of engine version, engine class name, and engine source SHA.

derivation_engine_source_sha.meaning: Git commit SHA of the governance engine implementation executing canonical derivation.

source_freeze_sha.authority: Repository Git commit database verified via git cat-file.
source_freeze_sha.expected_relationship_to_git_source: Must be an existing commit reachable in repository history.
source_freeze_sha.meaning: Authoritative Git commit SHA identifying the frozen implementation source against which the canonical governance decision was evaluated.

source_tree_oid.meaning: Git tree object ID identifying the exact filesystem state corresponding to source_freeze_sha.
